name: watch-coordinator-infra-classification
title: Watch coordinator cannot distinguish an infrastructure CI failure from a real one
description: sd-ship Stage 3's watch coordinator reports settled-blocked for both a genuine check failure and a GitHub-side infrastructure failure, so a run cannot tell a retry-worthy blocker from one that no retry will clear. Give the coordinator an infrastructure classification, or document that the operator must inspect job steps before deciding.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Deferred once by the operator on 2026-08-06 when the sibling fixes shipped in PR #156; tasked rather than dropped. The coordinator's outcome vocabulary is fixed at settled-green, settled-blocked, timed-out, and probe-failed (watch-coordinator.md:58-65) with no infrastructure category. Note that watch-coordinator.md is installed from the sd-ai-command-pack (.sd-ai-command-pack/manifest.json), so changing the coordinator itself is an upstream change; only the operator-facing guidance is editable in this repository. Sequencing: this task writes .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md at order 10 in the P3 band; write-set membership and the band-aware landing sequence are documented in .trellis/tasks/08-08-trellis-backlog-hygiene/record.md.
